purpose: Prove producer-independent cross-supplier verification: npm/Node produces CBOR, while a separately acquired PyPI implementation must decode and semantically verify it.
goal: Create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/NPM_CBOR_INDEPENDENT_SOURCE.json containing exactly four records with fields id and text: 1 alpha, 2 beta, 3 gamma, 4 delta. Using a zero-cost npm JavaScript library executed by Node.js, encode those exact records as CBOR and save canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/NPM_CBOR_INDEPENDENT_RECORDS.cbor. Finally independently decode the CBOR artifact using a different implementation that is not provided by the npm producer and verify the decoded records are exactly identical to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/NPM_CBOR_INDEPENDENT_SOURCE.json in values, order, field names, and record count.
